title: Art League of Ocean City

services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: Looking for a unique and inspiring venue for your next event? The Ocean City Center for the Arts offers a stunning setting that blends creativity with coastal charm-perfect for weddings, receptions, private parties, corporate meetings, and more! Surrounded by beautiful artwork and breathtaking views, our space provides the perfect backdrop for any occasion. Our meeting rooms feature a flat-screen TV for presentations, a wet bar area, and an integrated sound system throughout the building to enhance your experience.
